name: gcam-progress
description: A band above the prompt that follows running GCAM jobs: period, iterations, elapsed time, ETA and unsolved years. /gcam-progress prints the full table.

processName.title: GCAM process name
processName.description: Name of the GCAM executable to look for among your running processes.

exeFolders.title: GCAM exe folders to watch
exeFolders.description: Optional. Colon-separated folders or globs (for example ~/gcam/exe_*) whose logs/main_log.txt is checked for finished runs. Folders where gcam.exe runs while this plugin is active are always included.

runRecordsDir.title: Run records folder
runRecordsDir.description: Optional. A folder with one subfolder per run holding a timing.txt written by a run wrapper. See docs/run-records.md in the plugin.

chainLogDir.title: Chain log folder
chainLogDir.description: Optional. A folder with chain_*.status and chain_*.sh files, used for the queued line. See docs/run-records.md.
